title: DeepMind CEO Wants to Put the Brakes on AI (Only for Giants)
description:
The CEO of the world's biggest AI lab just became the first insider to hit the brakes on his own industry 🔥

Demis Hassabis, who runs Google DeepMind, put out a plan for global AI oversight. The core idea is a new U.S regulator built kind of like FINRA (the finance watchdog), and it would actually have real teeth, the power to slow down frontier models if they start turning dangerous.

Here's the part that got me. Only the giants would feel it. Startups and researchers stay completely untouched, which tells you alot about whos really in the crosshairs 😅

Slowing down AI used to be a thing academics debated in theory. Now its coming from inside the industry, and honestly the whole fight just went political ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
